item.title: AI Core
item.lead: This concluding page summarizes the editorial line without presenting the source claims as independently proven facts.

items: The dossier describes AI as a scaling factor for existing script and CRM practices.
The key boundary is not human versus machine, but transparent versus hidden automation.
KPIs and triggers can determine the ethical direction of AI systems.
Auditability of prompts, data, logs, and decision rules becomes a core prerequisite for research and oversight.

blocks.label: SOURCE STATUS
blocks.text: Based on the sections regarding algorithmic co-dependency, technical architecture, CRM pipelines, variable-reward funnels, chat automation, and the synthetic form of intimacy in the provided dossier. This Research Edition 4.0 adds current public source control as of September 19, 2026, and explicitly marks which figures/claims from the source material have not been independently verified.

Reading guide for further research. The source itself mentions legal documentation, technical data, and sociological analysis as three tracks for triangulation. In this edition, these tracks have been brought together as an editorial structure; they have not been externally verified.
